description: This is a unit test class for the FeatureCreated class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.things package. It contains tests verifying immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, error handling, and resource path generation for the FeatureCreated event object.

classes.name: FeatureCreatedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the FeatureCreated event implementation, including immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and error cases.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that instances of FeatureCreated are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods are correctly implemented for FeatureCreated.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Test that creating a FeatureCreated object with a null string ThingId throws a ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Test that creating a FeatureCreated object with a null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeature
methods.description: Test that creating a FeatureCreated object with a null Feature throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson method produces the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating a FeatureCreated instance from a valid JSON string.

methods.name: createInstanceFromJsonWithNullFeature
methods.description: Tests creating a FeatureCreated instance from JSON where the feature field is null.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getResourcePath returns the correct JSON pointer based on feature ID.
